title: meta.mantine
description: The Mantine-specific block of a wire item's `meta`. The interchange schema declares `meta` as `additionalProperties: true`, so `{ requires: 12345 }` passes the wire validator untouched — every Mantine behaviour reads this object, so it gets a schema of its own. Strict on the keys manteen acts on or displays, open to everything else: a newer manteen-kit may add keys, and an older manteen must ignore them rather than refuse the item. Note the http:// dialect id: ajv registers draft-07 under that form, so nothing here needs the `delete schema.$schema` workaround the kit applies to the vendored (https://) wire schema.

requires.description: semver range the item needs from @mantine/core. Fails CLOSED: a non-string here is a blocking `meta-invalid-requires`, because this is the safety mechanism that keeps a v9-only component off a v8 install. Whether the string is a valid range is a separate, downstream question (semver.validRange -> `mantine-malformed-metadata`, a warning) — a typo must not become an unclearable blocker.

provider.description: Identifier of the provider the item needs mounted, e.g. "MantineProvider". Fails OPEN: documentation for a check that already warns rather than refuses, and that can report satisfied falsely.

stylesApi.description: Component name -> selector names the item exposes through Mantine's Styles API. Fails OPEN: display-only.

themeFragment.description: A standalone createTheme(...) source inlined by the toolchain rather than listed in `files`, so a client that does not understand it cannot drop a stray theme file into the project. Fails OPEN: dropping it loses a theme contribution, which is recoverable; refusing the whole item is not.

path.description: Source path in the authoring repo. Reporting only — nothing is ever written here.

content.description: The fragment source, folded into the project theme by mergeThemeSource.

themeSummary.description: Syntax-only display summary derived from themeFragment. Fails OPEN: a malformed summary is dropped without affecting the fragment or installation.
